name: Ludmila Mikhailovna Grazovskaya
original_name: リュドミラ＝ミハイロヴナ＝グラゾフスカヤ
source:
[i]The mysterious stranger[/i]

A charming beauty who is always smiling and full of confidence.

She is friendly and talks to people in a relaxed manner, but there is something mysterious about her that makes her seem untrustworthy.

She seems to be aware of how her body looks to men and enjoys it.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]
